name: Lettere (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lettere (the letters L L L and SPQR on yellow) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI LETTERE in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Lettere, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Lettere arms — letters L L L and SPQR on yellow, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI LETTERE beneath the arms
